title: Algebra I — Patterns in God's Creation
description: Test your understanding of variables, equations, inequalities, linear functions, systems, and polynomials.

questions.question: What is the value of 3x + 7 when x = 5?
Solve for x: 2x - 8 = 14
questions.explanation: Add 8 to both sides: 2x = 22. Divide by 2: x = 11.

questions.question: When solving an inequality, you must flip the inequality sign when you:
options: Add a negative number to both sides
Multiply or divide both sides by a negative number
Graph the solution on a number line
questions.explanation: You must reverse the inequality sign whenever you multiply or divide both sides by a negative number, because this reverses the order of the numbers.

questions.question: In the equation y = mx + b, what does 'm' represent?
questions.explanation: In slope-intercept form y = mx + b, m represents the slope (rate of change) and b represents the y-intercept.

questions.question: What is the slope of a line that passes through points (1, 3) and (4, 9)?
A system of two linear equations has no solution when the lines are:
questions.explanation: When two lines are parallel (same slope, different y-intercepts), they never intersect, so the system has no solution.

questions.question: What is the degree of the polynomial 5x³ - 2x² + x - 8?
questions.explanation: The degree of a polynomial is the highest exponent. The term 5x³ has the highest exponent of 3, so the degree is 3.
